caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate or platter with a central decorative motif featuring a stylized vase containing various flowers. The design consists of a symmetrical arrangement with three large, tulip-like flowers at the top and sides, two daisy-like flowers, and several curved leaves and stems radiating from the vase. The vase itself is elaborately shaped with ornate curling handles and a scalloped body, decorated with lines, dots, and leaf-like patterns. The color palette consists mainly of shades of brown and green, with brown outlines and details accentuated by areas of green wash in the background and on the leaves. The surrounding background is a plain beige, and there are several inscriptions in brown within the circular border, some of which read "1828," "Monday," "E.H. Shellady," and "’36."
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
